name: ExecCommuteCoach
subtitle: Executive Commute Articulation Coach
description: ExecCommuteCoach is an acoustic‑first, eyes‑free verbal coaching app for commuters, providing pitch telemetry, filler detection, WPM tracking, and dynamic friction prompts to sharpen executive communication skills.
